title: Shaun the Sheep and the pizza.
lines: A clever sheep lives on a farm.
He lives there with the other sheep in the field.
He has a whistle and a clipboard.
The farmer is nice, but he never sees what the sheep get up to.
He has glasses that he's always losing.
One day Shaun smells something tasty.
It's coming from the farmer's house.
He whispers in the other sheep's ears.
First they have to distract Bitzer.
A little lamb, Timmy, throws a ball.
He has to run after it.
Then the sheep call the pizzeria on the farmer's phone.
The pizza man thinks someone is saying pizza with extra cheese.
He's coming to deliver the pizza!
One sheep on top of another.
They put on a big coat.
Now it looks like a person.
The pizza man rings the bell.
The sheep tower opens the door.
He gives the pizza man a warm knitted scarf.
The sheep run to the barn.
The sheep hide the pizza box under the hay.
But he only sees sheep chewing grass.
The farmer shrugs and goes back home.
Bitzer comes back with his ball.
He sees a bit of cheese on Shaun's mouth.
Shaun quickly gives Bitzer the last piece of pizza.
That night the sheep sleep with full tummies.
